messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync — want to lock the 'golden path' onboarding for the upcoming beta cohort (6 partners). Primary goals: predictable time-to-first-success, actionable feedback loops, and measurable success metrics. Need ops/eng/cs alignment on SLOs + scope tradeoffs. Key Qs: 1) minimal integration for wave 1 (embeddings-only vs chat) 2) support SLA during pilot window 3) data retention & logs. Ping @ken @nina @alex. TL;DR: propose weekly feedback + 2 canary partners first week.

ken (Eng): SG. Strong preference for embeddings-only in wave 1 to limit surface area and safety burden. If we do chat we need extra rerouting + safety checks. For embeddings-only I propose targets: p99 latency < 300ms and token/compute budget per partner — is $500/mo provisional OK? Also need model pinning + fallback plan.

nina (CS): embeddings-only aligns with CS playbook. Support SLA: 8am-6pm PT weekdays, 24h response for Sev2 during steady state. For the canary launches we should commit to 2-hr response during the launch window. We can run weekly cohort syncs + maintain an async Notion status page.

alex (DevEx): Agree embeddings-only. I'll assemble an integration kit (sample code, terraform snippets, Postman collection). Proposed acceptance tests to gate launch:
- onboarding script completes in <30m
- vector dim matches model spec
- quality eval pass rate >= 85% on the provided baseline
I'll include a tiny CLI to validate upsert/query flow.

samira (Research): Instrumentation is critical. Suggest baseline eval set per partner + rolling eval. Add a regression alert: trigger if mean cosine similarity drops > 0.05 vs baseline or if top-10 query accuracy drops > 10%. Also plan manual QA for top weekly queries.

maria (PM): Two follow-ups: 1) budget — provisional $500/mo infra per partner during beta, 2) canary cadence — onboard 2 partners Mon/Tue next week. @ken can we enforce model pinning + read-only fallback to a smaller model if capacity/quality issues arise? @ops-bot can you create a runbook placeholder we can iterate on?

ops-bot: Created runbook placeholder: /runbooks/beta-golden-path-1766667777. Template includes checklist, oncall contacts, rollback steps, and escalation matrix.

ken (Eng): We can do pinning + fallback to 'redwood-lite' binary. Will add a feature flag in console for per-partner model pin and fallback policy. Also note batching: default max_batch=32 may harm tail latency for low-volume partners; suggest max_batch=8 for canaries.

nina (CS): :thumbsup: I'll coordinate partner invites. Can we include a 5-question CS survey + NPS after week 2? Also propose weekly 30-min office hours for partners during the pilot.

alex (DevEx): Draft integration kit posted: https://notion.fake/redwood/beta-kit — includes quickstart curl, Node SDK snippet, and mini-CLI to test vector upsert/query. Feedback welcome; I'll add terraform + example manifest.

samira (Research): Add two subjective metrics to the telemetry plan: partner-reported 'usefulness' (1-5) and 'time-to-value' in days. Store these with partner metadata so we can correlate with eval scores.

maria (PM): Next steps: @alex share final kit by EOD Friday, @ken open PR for feature flag + fallback by Wed, @nina send invites + survey by Thu, @samira publish baseline eval sets. Reconvene next Mon 09:00 PT. If no objections I'll lock scope to embeddings-only for wave 1. :white_check_mark:

ken (Eng): No objections. One small ask: we must log token counts per request and attribute cost per partner for post-mortem.

nina (CS): Noted — I'll add a short onboarding checklist to the invite (steps + expected TTV).

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: next-sync ts=1766720000 (Mon 09:00 PT).
